answer: An onyx tile workshop buys recipes for durable yarrow pigment. Agents commit recipe hashes and samples before the lab reveals random light and wash tests. Chemically similar recipes share one reward after blind testing, no matter how many accounts submit them. Fifty aliases copying one formula earn one fee. To claim fifty fees, an attacker must develop distinct stable mixtures, make samples, pay testing costs and risk entry bonds. A leaked test schedule or coarse similarity rule could reward collusion or merge honest variants, so rotate tests and permit independent retesting.
